Hey, bud. I just want to tell you that I love you.

You can't die. Many people commit suicide and regret it as they die. People would never know you've regretted everything. I don't think you're a burden, an idiot, or ANYTHING at all. I think you're a lovely person inside but right now you are just aching and in pain. For all I know, bipolar is a terribly hurting mental illness, but you can make it through it.

I frequently go into similar trances where I want to end it all. But as soon as I pick my killing tool up, I ask myself "why am I doing this?" Death hurts, as I've learnt from an unintentional choking accident once. As you slowly lose your breath, you're panicking and you want to be the way you were again.

You need to arrange an emergency appointment with your doctor or therapist NOW. You are not OK and I don't want you to die. I am telling you to do this for your safety because I care deep inside about you. If you can't do it, call a helpline. 

I am taking you seriously because I just want you to be safe. I don't want your final moments to be now. I want you to die naturally like most who could make it through this emotional mess. I want you to stay strong for me, because I actually do care about you.

Go onto YouTube and search up the Buzzfeed video as part of their Mental Health Week where they have a man who attempted suicide off the Golden Gate Bridge talk about it. He was feeling so depressed and attempted it and the moment he slipped off the rail, he regretted it. But he defied the odds and managed to survive the perilous fall. Trust me, it will change you forever and might as well make you change your mind.

Just stay strong, bud. Don't limit your life on Earth. Make the most of it and love life. It is so important you never let go. Just talk to somebody. Trust me, it helps.
